{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Build a clean light-mode SvelteKit static website for an interior design blog + product showcase called Haven Edit. The style should feel premium like Stripe: lots of whitespace, soft gradients, rounded cards, subtle shadows, polished typography, simple icons, and smooth micro-interactions. This is only a static front-end site, no backend, no database, no login, no real APIs. Use mock/sample content only.

Project Goal
Create a modern editorial website where visitors can read interior design ideas and discover curated decor products. The site should look trustworthy, elegant, airy, and easy to browse on mobile and desktop.

Pages / Sections

1. Home Page
- Top navigation with logo: Haven Edit
- Menu links: Home, Blog, Product Picks, Style Guides, About, Contact
- Hero section:
  - Small badge: Interior Inspiration • Curated Decor • Modern Living
  - Headline: Design a Calmer, Warmer Home With Thoughtful Details
  - Short paragraph about simple interior design tips, room inspiration, and handpicked decor finds
  - CTA buttons: Read the Blog and Explore Product Picks
  - Right side visual: layered glass cards showing room moodboard, color palette, featured chair, and “This Week’s Pick”
- Trust/feature strip:
  - 120+ Room Ideas
  - 35 Style Guides
  - 80 Curated Products
  - Weekly Decor Notes
- Featured blog cards section with 3 posts
- Featured product showcase section with 4 decor products
- Style categories section: Minimal, Japandi, Warm Modern, Small Spaces, Natural Textures, Rental Friendly
- Newsletter-looking block, but static only, just an input and button with no submission required

2. Blog Page
- Blog listing layout with filter chips: All, Living Room, Bedroom, Kitchen, Small Spaces, Color Ideas
- Use static mock articles
- Each article card should include category, title, excerpt, author name, date, read time, and image placeholder/gradient block
- Include a large featured article at the top
- Blog cards should have a premium editorial feel, not cluttered

Sample blog articles:
- 7 Warm Neutral Ideas That Make a Room Feel Finished
- How to Layer Lighting Without Making a Space Feel Busy
- Small Apartment Styling Rules That Actually Work
- The Beginner’s Guide to Mixing Wood Tones
- Calm Bedroom Details Designers Always Notice
- How to Build a Moodboard Before Buying Furniture

3. Product Picks Page
- Static product showcase grid for interior decor items
- Each product card should include product name, category, short description, price range, style tag, and “View Details” button
- No checkout, no cart, no real store functionality
- Add comparison-style highlight cards similar to SaaS pricing/product cards but for decor
- Product categories:
  - Seating
  - Lighting
  - Rugs
  - Storage
  - Wall Decor
  - Tabletop

Sample products:
- Luna Bouclé Accent Chair — Seating — Soft sculptural chair for reading corners — $240–$380
- Arlo Linen Floor Lamp — Lighting — Warm diffused light with a simple silhouette — $90–$160
- Sora Flatweave Rug — Rugs — Low-profile neutral rug for high traffic rooms — $180–$420
- Cove Ceramic Vase Set — Tabletop — Handmade-feel vases for shelves and consoles — $35–$75
- Northline Oak Shelf — Storage — Slim open shelf for books and objects — $120–$260
- Vale Textured Wall Art — Wall Decor — Calm abstract piece for modern interiors — $60–$140

4. Style Guide Detail Section/Page
Create one sample style guide page or detailed section called “Warm Modern Living Room”. It should include:
- Hero image placeholder/card
- Overview paragraph
- Color palette chips with hex labels
- Materials list: oak, linen, wool, ceramic, matte black metal
- Layout tips in a checklist style
- Product pairing cards
- Related posts

5. About Page / Section
- Short brand story: Haven Edit is a calm design journal for people who want a beautiful home without overcomplicating it
- Values cards:
  - Practical Beauty
  - Timeless Materials
  - Small-Space Friendly
  - Budget-Aware Styling
- Add founder/editor card using mock information

6. Contact Page / Section
- Static contact layout only
- Include email placeholder: hello@havenedit.example
- Include mock office/location text: Studio based online, serving design lovers everywhere
- Include a contact form UI with name, email, topic, message, but no backend submission required
- Add note: “This demo form is static.”

Chatbot Interaction Requirement
Add a small floating chatbot widget in the bottom-right corner. This should be static/front-end only, no AI API and no external service. It can open/close and show scripted sample responses. The bot name: Haven Helper.

Chatbot behavior:
- Floating button with chat icon and label “Ask Haven Helper”
- On click, open a small chat panel
- Welcome message: “Hi! I can help you find a room style, color palette, or decor pick.”
- Provide 3 quick reply buttons:
  - Help me choose a style
  - Suggest a color palette
  - Show decor picks
- When clicked, show a predefined mock response in the chat window
- Add a small input field for visual realism, but it does not need to connect anywhere
- Keep it elegant, not cartoonish

Visual Style
- Light theme only
- Inspired by Stripe: polished, spacious, subtle gradients, soft shadows, clean cards, strong hierarchy
- Background: warm white / off-white with very light beige and pale blue gradient accents
- Use modern sans-serif typography
- Add tasteful editorial serif accent for large headings if easy
- Rounded corners: 20px+ for cards
- Use glassmorphism only subtly for hero cards and chatbot panel
- Mobile-first responsive layout
- Smooth hover states for cards and buttons

Suggested Color Palette
- Background: #FAF8F4
- Surface: #FFFFFF
- Text: #1F2933
- Muted Text: #6B7280
- Accent Clay: #C98566
- Accent Sage: #9AAA8C
- Accent Blue: #DDEAF6
- Border: #E8E2D9
- Soft Gradient: cream to blush to pale blue

Components Needed
- Header/nav
- Hero section
- Stat/trust strip
- Blog card
- Product card
- Category chip
- Style guide card
- Color palette chip
- Newsletter block
- Static contact form
- Floating chatbot widget
- Footer

Footer
- Logo and short description
- Columns:
  - Explore: Blog, Product Picks, Style Guides
  - Rooms: Living Room, Bedroom, Kitchen, Entryway
  - Resources: Color Palettes, Shopping Notes, Styling Tips
- Social text links only, no real integrations
- Copyright line for 2026 Haven Edit

Content Rules
- Use only mock/static/sample content
- No real API calls
- No external authentication
- No payment, cart, checkout, or account features
- No server actions needed
- No database
- No admin area
- No CRUD features
- No real chatbot service
- The site should be renderable as a static SvelteKit front-end

Deliverable
Please create the full SvelteKit static website with clean reusable components, responsive styling, and enough sample content so the site feels complete. Prioritize visual polish and realistic product/blog presentation over complex functionality.",

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
# webdev-structural-gate@1: necessary conditions, not a replacement judge.
_gate_layout = {}
for _line in (shot["output"] or "").splitlines():
    if _line.startswith("LAYOUT:"):
        try:
            _gate_layout = json.loads(_line[len("LAYOUT:"):])
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
        break
if (not isinstance(_gate_layout, dict) or _gate_layout.get("error")
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("text"), str)
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("scroll_w"), (int, float))
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("client_w"), (int, float))
        or _gate_layout["client_w"] <= 0):
    done(None, "Structural measurements unavailable; not scored.")
_gate_text = " ".join(_gate_layout["text"].split())
_gate_kw = cfg.get("gate_keywords") or []
_gate_fails = []
if not _gate_text:
    _gate_fails.append("blank rendered DOM")
if _gate_kw and not any(_kw.casefold() in _gate_text.casefold() for _kw in _gate_kw):
    _gate_fails.append("no brief-keyword DOM presence")
if _gate_layout["scroll_w"] > _gate_layout["client_w"] + 1:
    _gate_fails.append("horizontal overflow")
_gate_report = {"passed": not _gate_fails, "failed": _gate_fails,
                "dom_chars": len(_gate_text), "keywords": _gate_kw,
                "layout": _gate_layout}
(V / "structural_gates.json").write_text(json.dumps(_gate_report, indent=1))
if _gate_fails:
    done(0.0, "Structural gates failed: " + "; ".join(_gate_fails),
         structural_gates=_gate_fails)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Gate trivial, off-brief and overflowing pages to a scored 0 before the vision call, cutting judge spend and the blank-page lottery. Passing pages reach the judge unchanged.
